title: Driver Terms Recorded against the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan Levels
content:
Who may drive on a trip covered by the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan, how many drivers besides the guest
the level will approve and what those drivers cost are written into the level itself. The minimum driver age and
the minimum marketplace driver score are the youngest driver and the lowest score the level will cover; the
additional drivers approved is the number of drivers beyond the guest the level will take on one trip, each
charged the level's additional driver fee; the young-driver surcharge is the percentage recorded against the
level; and the last two columns state whether a licence issued outside the country is accepted and whether the
guest must evidence their own motor policy, with the least third-party limit that policy must carry.

| Protection level | Minimum driver age (whole years) | Minimum marketplace driver score | Additional drivers approved | Additional driver fee (USD) | Young-driver surcharge recorded (percent) | Licence issued outside the country accepted | Own motor policy must be evidenced | Least third-party limit on the guest's own policy (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyturn Declined Protection | 25 | 80 | 1 | 25.00 | 0 | no | yes | 50000.00 |
| Keyturn Minimum Protection | 21 | 68 | 1 | 22.00 | 25 | yes | no | 0.00 |
| Keyturn Standard Protection | 21 | 70 | 2 | 20.00 | 22 | yes | no | 0.00 |
| Keyturn Advantage Protection | 21 | 72 | 3 | 18.00 | 18 | yes | no | 0.00 |
| Keyturn Premier Protection | 21 | 74 | 4 | 0.00 | 15 | yes | no | 0.00 |
| Keyturn Business Traveler Protection | 23 | 76 | 5 | 0.00 | 12 | yes | no | 0.00 |

## The same terms as a set of questions the schedule answers

**Which level admits the youngest driver?** Every level except Keyturn Declined Protection and Keyturn Business
Traveler Protection admits a driver of 21 whole years; Keyturn Business Traveler Protection admits 23 and
Keyturn Declined Protection 25.

**Which level admits the lowest marketplace driver score?** Keyturn Minimum Protection, at 68; the ladder then
runs 70, 72, 74 and 76, with Keyturn Declined Protection the strictest of all at 80.

**Which levels carry no additional driver fee?** Keyturn Premier Protection and Keyturn Business Traveler
Protection, both written at 0.00 USD, while approving four and five additional drivers respectively.

**On which level must the guest evidence their own motor policy?** Keyturn Declined Protection alone, and that
policy must carry a third-party limit of at least 50000.00 USD; on every other level the requirement is not
written and the limit recorded is 0.00 USD.

## Boundary reading

A licence issued outside the country is accepted on five of the six levels and is not accepted on Keyturn
Declined Protection. On the same level the young-driver surcharge recorded stands at 0 percent, while the
figure recorded falls as the ladder rises, from 25 percent on Keyturn Minimum Protection to 12 percent on
Keyturn Business Traveler Protection.
